verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.recruitee.com that indexes endpoint documentation. It states that appending .md to any docs URL returns a markdown version, and a second probe confirms .md pages are served and point back to the llms.txt index. That gives agents a clear, agent-oriented entry point into the API reference. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at any probed path (all 404), and no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt or independent reports of agent use.
